entries.title_before: k-points of k[x_1, ..., x_n]/I are exactly k-algebra maps to k
entries.title_after: $k$-points of $k[x_1, \ldots, x_n]/I$ are exactly $k$-algebra maps to $k$

scientific_review.reason: Polynomial universal property identifies a map by its finitely many coordinate images; vanishing of I is precisely the condition to factor evaluation through the quotient. Both constructions are inverse. Title delimiters and the ellipsis command preserve that exact assertion over an arbitrary field.
